title: Ricci flow, Einstein metrics and space forms
container-title: Transactions of the American Mathematical Society
fields.abstract: The main results in this paper are: (1) Ricci pinched stable Riemannian metrics can be deformed to Einstein metrics through the Ricci flow of R. Hamilton; (2) (suitably) negatively pinched Riemannian manifolds can be deformed to hyperbolic space forms through Ricci flow; and (3) L 2 {L^2} -pinched Riemannian manifolds can be deformed to space forms through Ricci flow.
